name: Shuyaku Hyland
source:
Despite being born into a wealthy family and attending the prestigious Hyde Collegiate Institute, Shuyaku Hyland, is an insubordinate high school student who finds his own life rather boring. 

Failing class and frequently getting into fights, his delinquent nature often causes the other students to scoff at him; viewing him as rather plebeian and uncivilized.

However, this boring disruptive life of his soon comes to 
an end when he receives a book, from his father, teaching 
him the art of hypnosis. 

With his newfound abilities, he decides to embark on a quest to make his life a bit more interesting; potentially bringing meaning to an, otherwise, meaningless existence.
